answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric verification acts as a yarrow of sorts, binding a distinct biological signature to each agent node. Unlike a digital fable of infinite identities, this system requires a ferrous layer of hardware security to prevent spoofing. An attacker attempting a Sybil strike must procure genuine human identities at a high market cost, rendering the capital expenditure of maintaining thousands of unique, verified nodes economically prohibitive compared to any potential network gain.
